title: MP Sprint B chunk 3 — server-side pickup spawn + pickup collect + round resolve + tally
notes: Third of 4 sprints implementing GDP-2026-05-22-011 (server-authoritative kaboom-crew). Sequencing per docs/research/kaboom-multiplayer-sprint-b-plan.md §3: S117 ✅ → S118 ✅ → S119 pickup+round-resolve (this) → S120 bot-AI + cleanup.

Scope vs sprint-b-plan.md §3.S119: ship server-side pickup spawn (deterministic per-cell RNG), pickup collect (stat application), round-resolve broadcast, tally tracking. EXPLICITLY OUT of scope for S119: round auto-restart (S120 concerns) + multi-round MatchState lifecycle (the existing client-side MatchState stays single-player-only).
Acceptance for S119: tab A walks over a server-spawned pickup → both tabs see the pickup disappear + tab A's BomberStats.maxBombs += 1. Round resolves on both tabs simultaneously with the same tally.

stories.title: Server spawns pickups deterministically when soft blocks are destroyed
stories.summary: On each blockDestroyed event in the server's tick (S118 wired the destroy path), roll a deterministic per-cell RNG seeded by (worldSeed ^ cellHash(gx,gz)). If roll < dropChance (default 0.3), pick a kind from the drop table (bomb-up×2, fire-up×2, speed-up×2, kick, remote-detonate, shield) and spawn a Pickup entity on the server ECS world. Snapshot ships Pickup + GridPosition + Transform so clients can render. blockDestroyed message gains droppedPickupKind so clients can play the spawn anim immediately (before snapshot delivers the entity).
verification: acceptance: Server now spawns pickup entities deterministically when soft blocks are destroyed. Per-cell xorshift32 seeded by (worldSeed XOR cellHash(gx,gz)) — same cell always produces the same kind on the same world seed, so bot-vs-bot replays stay reproducible. Drop probability default 0.3 (configurable). Drop table mirrors the client (bomb-up x2, fire-up x2, speed-up x2, kick, remote-detonate, shield). On a hit, server adds a 'pickup.<kind>.<n>.<gx>.<gz>' entity with Pickup + GridPosition + Transform components — these ride the snapshot to all clients. blockDestroyed protocol message gains droppedPickupKind so clients can play the spawn FX immediately before the snapshot diff applies.

+4 unit tests covering: dropChance=1 emits droppedPickupKind for every cell, dropChance=0 emits none, snapshot ships Pickup entities, determinism by cell, divergence across worldSeeds

stories.title: Server detects pickup collection + applies stat effects + emits pickupCollected
stories.summary: Each server tick, walk pickups vs alive bomber GridPositions. On a match: apply the effect to the bomber's BomberStats (bomb-up→maxBombs+1 cap 8, fire-up→range+1 cap 8, etc.), remove the pickup entity, emit pickupCollected{entityId, kind, gx, gz, pickerId}. speed-up bumps a separate playerSpeed component or BomberStats.speed (skipped for S119 since the GridMover/speed model lives client-side). Kick + remote-detonate + shield: server records the flag/counter on BomberStats but client systems still gate the actual gameplay (kick mechanic + shield consumption logic stays client-side this sprint; S120 cleanup).
verification: acceptance: Server now authoritatively detects pickup collection. Each tick after movement integration writes new GridPositions, ServerWorld scans pickups vs alive bombers; matching cells trigger applyPickupEffect on BomberStats + emit pickupCollected{entityId,kind,gx,gz,pickerId}. Stat caps mirror the client (maxBombs cap 8, range cap 8, remote-detonate cap 3, kick + shield idempotent). speed-up has no server-side effect this sprint (speed model still lives client-side; deferred). pickupCollected broadcast via transport-ws to all clients. Snapshot ships extended BomberStats (canKick / remoteDetonateCharges / shield) so client HUD reads from one source.

examples/backends/node-world-server/src/transport-ws.ts: ProtocolMessage adds pickupCollected variant; tick loop drains + broadcasts
+4 unit tests: bomber walking onto pickup collects+emits event, bomb-up increments maxBombs, fire-up increments range, dead bomber doesn't collect

stories.title: Server tracks alive bomber count; emits roundResolved at ≤1 alive
stories.summary: Server maintains an implicit alive count via BomberStats.alive on player.<id> entities. When the playing-phase bomber count drops to ≤1, emit roundResolved{phase, winnerId, tally, nextRoundAt}. Phase: 'won' when there's exactly one survivor, 'draw' when zero (simultaneous death). winnerId: the surviving player's entityId. nextRoundAt: 3.0 s (informational only — server doesn't auto-reset in S119). After resolve, ServerWorld locks: subsequent placeBombRequest is refused. Idempotent — once emitted, the event isn't re-broadcast every tick.
verification: acceptance: Server tracks alive bomber count via BomberStats.alive on player.<id> entities. Once the count drops to ≤1 in a 2+ player session, server emits a SINGLE roundResolved{phase, winnerId, tally, nextRoundAt} broadcast. Phase mapping uses first-joined-player slot conventions: alive[0] winning + winnerJoinIndex==0 → 'won' + tally.player+=1; non-first-winner → 'lost' + tally.bot+=1; zero survivors → 'draw' + tally.draws+=1. nextRoundAt=3.0s informational (server doesn't auto-reset in S119 — that's S120). After resolve, placeBomb() refuses new bombs and dead bombers also can't place — locks the round end-state until reset. Idempotent: subsequent ticks don't re-emit.

stories.title: Server-side RoundState singleton entity carries phase + tally + roundNumber
stories.summary: Maintain a `kaboom.round-state` entity on the server ECS world with RoundState{phase, tally:{player,bot,draws}, roundNumber}. Snapshot ships RoundState so clients (and the HUD scoreboard) can render the cross-round state from the authoritative source on connected. Tally increments on each roundResolved (server picks the winning slot based on winnerId mapping — first-joined player counts as 'player' slot, others as 'bot' slot for the canonical 2-player session). Cross-round persistence; restart is S120.
verification: acceptance: A canonical kaboom.round-state entity now lives on the server ECS world from boot. RoundState{phase, tally:{player,bot,draws}, roundNumber, winnerId?} ships in the snapshot — clients (HUD scoreboard + future server-driven banner) read the authoritative state from one source instead of guessing from local RoundState. Tally increments on each roundResolved per the slot mapping (first-joiner = 'player', others = 'bot', draws on simultaneous death). roundNumber stays at 1 in S119 (no auto-reset; S120 will bump it on round restart). Cross-round persistence built into the singleton.

stories.title: Client connected profile drops local pickup-spawn + pickup-collect
stories.summary: On the `connected` profile, narrow pickup-spawn-system + pickup-collect-system profiles to ['static']. The server's snapshot delivers Pickup entities directly; the existing client-side render pipeline (MeshRenderer + GridOccupant) picks them up unchanged. Collection visuals: client connected-blast-decoder gains a pickup branch that consumes pickupCollected events for the spark FX + audio cue (the entity itself is removed via snapshot diff). Static profile keeps the local pipeline intact.
verification: acceptance: pickup-spawn-system + pickup-collect-system profiles narrowed to ['static']. On connected the server is authoritative on both spawn and collect; the local collect path would otherwise double-apply stat effects to player.1 on top of the server's pickerId=player.<connId>. Snapshot delivers server Pickup entities directly + entity.create lands them in the local world for rendering through the existing MeshRenderer pipeline. Local pickup visuals (PARTICLE_EMITTER, Tween scale-pop) don't fire on connected since the server spawn skips those project-specific decorations — a cosmetic gap to address in S120.
examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: pickup-spawn + pickup-collect profile narrowed to ['static']
All 1375 unit tests pass; typecheck clean; MP e2e green (existing two tests both pass)

stories.title: Playwright e2e: alpha collects a pickup; bravo sees it gone + roundResolved on both tabs
stories.summary: Extend tests/e2e/kaboom-multiplayer-roundtrip.spec.ts: bait the server's deterministic pickup RNG (set worldSeed via URL or default) so a soft-block destruction reliably yields a pickup. Alpha walks over it → both tabs see the Pickup entity disappear from the snapshot + alpha's BomberStats.maxBombs incremented. Second test: alpha self-kills (places bomb on her cell) → both tabs see RoundState.phase flip to 'won' (bravo winning) with the right tally.
verification: acceptance: kaboom-multiplayer-roundtrip.spec.ts gained a 4th test that exercises the full S119 server-authoritative pickup pipeline end-to-end. Server boots with KABOOM_PICKUP_DROP_CHANCE=1.0 so every soft-block destruction drops a pickup deterministically. Alpha walks (via gotoCell) to (4,3) → places a bomb → server destroys soft.1 at (4,5) → server spawns Pickup entity at (4,5) → both tabs see the Pickup in their snapshot → alpha drives the server's player.alpha onto the pickup cell via the new __agf.sendNetworkIntent probe (closed-loop control: poll snapshot + emit intent.move; stop when GridPosition matches target) → server's pickup-collect scan removes the Pickup entity + emits pickupCollected → snapshot diff propagates entity.delete to both tabs. Test stays green on both chromium and chromium-preview.
